thread.title: Apple does not know how to impose on users iPhone XR

author: Erika J. Wells
title: Apple does not know how to impose on users iPhone XR
text:
Apple does not know how to impose on users iPhone XR 09.12.2018
Apple continues to promote a campaign for replacing your old iOS smartphone iPhone XR. This time with the help of the best apps in the section “Today” in the App Store. 1
The article describes the basic function of the iPhone XR, and then learn about the applications that take advantage of new hardware – sensor Face ID and chip A12 Bionic.
It’s pretty tough marketing course, which follows the recent notification app Apple Store “limited time” offers to replace your old iPhone model XR. 2
It is noteworthy that Apple is so aggressive is a month after the beginning of sales of smartphone.
The category of “Today,” calling for the exchange on the iPhone XR came from users of the us App Store. It is worth noting that the offer only appears on older iPhone models. 3
The article itself, in addition to advertising iPhone XR, dedicated apps such as Sky Guide, HBO Now, Halide Camera, HomeCourt and Clips. It also focused on the power chip A12, advantage security system, Face ID, the iPhone’s camera and XR best time of Autonomous operation of the smartphone.
All of this is directly related to the weak sales. Shares of AAPL now continue to fall in price, as Apple’s reported decline in orders in all directions, as investors worried that demand for iPhone iPhone XS and XR will be the lowest in company history.
